title: Points Game (Basic Geometrical Ideas) - https://points-game-draft.netlify.app/
note: Reviewed 28 Sep 2026. LP and skill statement not available.

1.observation: No LP or skill statement available. Game covers point, line segment, line and ray (NCERT Class 6, Basic Geometrical Ideas).
1.correction: Attach the skill statement the game is built for.

2.observation: Scene 16 'Connect A and B with the shortest path': a drag by a long detour is accepted because the game always draws a straight line. Scenes 26-27: the pair can be found by trial, as the answer glows after two misses.
2.correction: Check the drag path, or change the task so the child has to judge shortest path.

3.observation: Definitions of point, segment, line and ray are correct. Note: scene 11 picture of lines through a point is drawn as arrows from one centre and reads like rays.
3.correction: Draw full lines with arrowheads at both ends through the point.

4.observation: Grade not stated. Wording ('precise location', 'extended endlessly') matches the Class 6 textbook.
4.correction: State the target grade in the LP.

6.observation: Islands, houses and stars as points need no outside knowledge.

7.observation: No task tests the usual confusions: segment vs line vs ray, or a curved path counting as a segment.
7.correction: Add items where the child must tell segment, line and ray apart.

8.observation: Line and ray are each shown for about 5 s (scenes 15a, 15b) and never practised or checked. All five practices are about joining two points.
8.correction: Add practice and a check for line and ray, or remove them from this game.

9.observation: Starts from point, then joining points, then segment.

10.observation: Order: point > lines through a point > segment > line > ray > practice on segments.

11.observation: Two dots > three houses > eight islands with distractors > four letter points > six points, eight joins.

12.observation: Segment is demonstrated (scenes 12-15) before the first practice in scene 16.

13.observation: Five practices using dots, pictures and letters; each is used before it is checked.

14.observation: After the guide line, the next rounds are done without help (scenes 26-27).

15.observation: Scene 16: 195 s idle at 'Draw a point', nothing happens. Scene 19 shows a pen after about 4 s. Scenes 21, 26, 27 help only after mistakes, not when idle. No glow > ghost hand > Swiftee order anywhere.
15.correction: Add idle help in the LP order to every practice.

16.observation: Retry is always allowed. The guide line appears only after 2-3 misses. Miss count cannot be checked without the LP.
16.correction: Confirm the miss count against the LP.

17.observation: End screen: 'You mapped the whole Cloud Colony!' Names the story task, not the skill.
17.correction: Add a line naming what was learnt: points, line segments, lines, rays.

18.observation: Support points are defined in the LP, which is not available.

19.observation: No Swiftee character appears in the game; Maya is on the banner. Whether Swiftee is required needs the LP.

20.observation: Scenes 19, 21, 26, 27 step up: prompt > named pair > glow > guide line. Scene 16 has only the eraser pulse.
20.correction: Add the same progression to scene 16.

21.observation: Scene 12 says 'Now, join them' but there is nothing to do and it moves on. Scene 16 banner says 'Connect A and B with the shortest path' while the voice says 'Press point A and drag to point B'. Scene 20 START has no instruction.
21.correction: Remove 'join them' from scene 12 or make it a task; make banner and voice say the same thing.

22.observation: The joining shown in scenes 12-15 is the action used in every practice.

23.observation: No colour, size or position gives the correct pair away before a mistake.

24.observation: Scene 19: a correct tap on a house plays the wrong-answer sound and says 'Oops! Try again.' Reproduced twice. The tap also reaches the board behind the house, which treats it as a miss.
24.correction: Stop the house tap from reaching the board miss handler.

25.observation: Wrong answers say what to do next ('Tap the eraser...', 'Look for points A and C. Join them.').

26.correction: Recheck if the target grade is lower.

27.observation: Same object called point, house and island ('Tap on any two points' over houses; 'unsafe house' for an island). Action called draw, join, connect, tap, press and drag.
27.correction: Use one word for the object and one for the action per screen.

28.observation: Scene 25 speech bubble is not read aloud. All practices and the line/ray frames use device text-to-speech, which may be missing or sound different on a low-end Android. Ray frame: voice says 'For example: Sun's rays.' while the banner shows the definition.
28.correction: Record all practice lines, the bubble text and the line/ray narration.

29.observation: Scene 12 A and B look exactly like the tappable points in scene 16 but do nothing.
29.correction: Make demonstration points look different, or make them interactive.

30.observation: At 812x375 (phone landscape), scene 27 points C, D, F are about 25 px apart with 10 px dots. Fine at 1280x800.
30.correction: Enlarge and space the dots, or fix the target device as tablet.

31.observation: Taps while narration or an intro plays get no response (scenes 16 and 21).
31.correction: Give a small response, such as a shake or repeating the instruction.

32.observation: START and PLAY AGAIN are clear buttons; everything else advances by itself.

33.observation: No replay, pause or mute control anywhere.
33.correction: Add a replay button for the current instruction.

34.observation: Right and wrong are shown by sound, banner text and the line pulling back, not colour alone.

35.observation: At 1024x768 the scene 16 board is cut off at the bottom. Fits at 1280x800.
